defense_news.title: Pentagon, Raytheon sign $6.3B deal to replenish US missile interceptor supply
defense_news.summary: The contract "supports urgent replenishment of missile defense inventory that has been successfully used in combat," Raytheon said.

defense_news.title: US Army activates new multi-domain task force to ‘deny, disrupt’ enemies in Indo-Pacific
defense_news.summary: The new 4th Multi-Domain Task Force includes four battalions and is planned to grow to 2,100 soldiers.

defense_news.title: US Army Corps of Engineers failed to explain drop in environmental mitigation work: Watchdog
defense_news.summary: A chart published by GAO shows a sharp decline in the agency's decisions to make mitigation plans for wildlife and habitat protection from 2022 to 2025.

defense_news.title: Official poster depicts the US Army’s newest threat: The Iranian soldier
defense_news.summary: The U.S. Army recently published a quick-recognition guide to help soldiers identify members of the Iranian army.
